findings.label: SelectExistingTenant missing preselectedPropertyId
findings.detail: In the add-tenant-from-wizard path, SelectExistingTenant is not passed preselectedPropertyId={selectedProperty?.id}. If the component requires the caller to supply the target property ID to perform the tenant-to-property association, the user will land on property-details for a property with no tenant linked. Add the prop, or confirm the component auto-assigns using selectedProperty from surrounding state.

findings.label: Add Another Tenant re-entry with live sentinel
findings.detail: After a successful save in the wizard flow, the AddTenant success screen's 'Add Another Tenant' button resets the form internally without calling onBack, leaving previousScreen === 'add-tenant-from-wizard' set. A second tenant save correctly uses selectedProperty.id, but if selectedProperty is cleared by a background refresh between saves, the save throws 'Cannot link tenant: the property was not found.' Add a guard or a comment documenting the invariant that selectedProperty must remain set.

findings.label: Partial image-upload silent degradation
findings.detail: When some but not all image uploads fail, savePropertyFromWizard saves the property with a reduced photo set and shows no warning to the user. Surface a non-blocking message (e.g. '2 of 4 photos uploaded — add the rest from Property Details'). Same gap exists in onPublish; fix together.
